summary: Millrose Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, reporting completion of a $1.0 billion private placement of senior unsecured notes in two tranches: $500.0 million of 6.500% senior notes due 2029 and $500.0 million of 6.750% senior notes due 2031, sold under Rule 144A and Regulation S. The notes are guaranteed by subsidiaries Millrose Properties SPE LLC and MPSAB, LLC, rank pari passu with existing senior debt, and were issued under indentures with Citibank, N.A. as trustee. No price, premium, or transaction terms beyond coupon and maturity were stated; this is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
